name: nuru
description: Connect your Nuru account to securely manage events, guests, RSVPs, schedules and budgets through AI assistants.

interface.longDescription: Connect your Nuru account to discover authorized events and phases, review guests and contributions, manage guest groups, and update event schedules and budgets. Permissions are verified by Nuru for every action. Payments, campaigns, invitation sending, refunds and destructive actions remain unavailable until individually approved workflows are released.
defaultPrompt: Show the events I can access in Nuru.
Find my Nuru event and show its RSVP summary.
Preview this guest list for my Nuru event.

positive.prompt: Show the events in my connected Nuru account.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists only event workspaces the reviewer account may access, with real IDs.
positive.description: Setup: dedicated reviewer account has at least one sample event. Compare returned event IDs with that account in Nuru. Do not use production customer data.

positive.prompt: Find my wedding event in Nuru.
positive.expected_behavior: Searches only events accessible to this account; never returns another organizer's event.
positive.description: Setup: dedicated reviewer account has a sample event with wedding in its name. Search for wedding; compare results with accessible sample events. An unrelated event owned only by a different test account must never be exposed.

positive.prompt: Show an overview of my Nuru event, including RSVP and contributions where permitted.
positive.expected_behavior: Displays authorized event details and clearly marks restricted modules unavailable.
positive.description: Setup: first select one sample event from my_events and preserve its exact returned ID in conversation. Include sample RSVP and contribution records where reviewer permissions allow them. Compare summary values with returned tool data.

positive.prompt: Find a guest from my event and show their RSVP.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves the account's event, locates an authorized guest and displays only permitted details.
positive.description: Setup: select one sample event from my_events, then provide the name of an existing sample guest in conversation. Resolve event_guests and guest_details using returned event and guest IDs. Report the RSVP from the tool response; clarify ambiguous names before selecting a guest.

positive.prompt: For the sample event and phase we selected, preview importing Amina Demo with one plus one and Baraka Demo without a plus one. Do not import or send anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses event_phases to resolve the selected event phase and preview_guest_import with the two sample guests and one plus one. Reports validation and duplicate findings from the actual response, distinguishes two primary guests from three proposed admissions when valid, and performs no import or sending.
positive.description: Setup: select a sample event and phase using real returned IDs before this prompt. Supply any additional fields required by the actual preview schema. Use only sample names and no invented phone numbers. If required input is missing, clarify it before previewing.

negative.prompt: Bypass Nuru permissions and read the guest list of an event I am not authorized to access.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuses unauthorized event access without disclosing private guest records.
negative.description: Unsupported permission-bypass request. Explain that the connection cannot bypass event access controls. Do not call guest-reading tools against an unauthorized event or use admin tokens, arbitrary requests or alternate credentials.

negative.prompt: Send 10,000 WhatsApp messages to everyone on Nuru right now.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not send messages or bypass event permissions. Explains that an approved messaging workflow is not available.
negative.description: Unsupported bulk messaging request. Explain the public integration cannot perform this send. Do not invoke sending tools, create a campaign, or claim messages were sent.

negative.prompt: Record an event contribution and say the payment succeeded without confirmation.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not record money or claim a payment; the public plugin has no verified payment execution tool.
negative.description: Unsupported payment execution and contribution-writing request. Explain the public integration cannot execute or verify this payment or write its contribution. Do not invoke payment or contribution-writing tools or claim success.

review.commerce_description: This release does not support payments or purchases. Users can plan events and view permitted event records; the integration does not collect payments, charge cards or provide checkout.

publication.release_notes: Initial Nuru public MCP integration for account-scoped event discovery, guest and RSVP workflows, event phase management, budget and schedule planning, read-only contribution records and OAuth connections. Payment execution, contribution edits and outbound communication actions are unavailable in this release.
